blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The municipal administrations of Balamban, Pinamungajan, and Barili have backed former Deputy Speaker and ex-Cebu 3rd District Representative Pablo John Garcia’s call to reduce real property and other taxes in Cebu Province, citing the prolonged difficulties affecting families and local enterprises. Garcia is pushing to reduce real property tax, sand and gravel tax, and other charges, saying ordinary Cebu residents can no longer bear ongoing economic challenges. On September 15, the Balamban Municipal Council ratified a resolution supporting Garcia’s tax-rollback campaign.
